courses.name: Professional Development for Mechanical Engineers
courses.description: Fundamental knowledge and skills for academic and professional development in ME: communication, design process, problem solving, measurements/data analysis, professionalism, safety, IP.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 1A Mechanical Engineering.

courses.name: Engineering Communication & Critical Decision Making
courses.description: Communication, critical thinking and decision-making skills oriented to ME practice; oral/written formats, teamwork.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 1B Mechanical Engineering.

courses.name: Introduction to Methods of Engineering Design
courses.description: Methods and skills for engineering design: problem definition, concept generation, selection, scheduling, prototyping; teamwork and communication.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 1B Mechanical Engineering.

courses.name: Mechanics
courses.description: Equilibrium of rigid bodies; trusses/frames; shear/moment; friction; centroids/area moments; applications.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 1A Mechanical Engineering. Antireq: MTE 121/GENE 121.

courses.name: Advanced Calculus for Mechanical Engineering 1
courses.description: Vector calculus incl. line/surface integrals; field theory; ODEs with applications.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: MATH 119; Level at least 2A Mechanical Engineering.

courses.name: Advanced Calculus for Mechanical Engineering 2
courses.description: Fourier series and transforms; PDEs of mathematical physics; numerical methods; applications.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 201; Level at least 2B Mechanical Engineering.

courses.name: Mechanics of Deformable Solids
courses.description: Stress and strain; axial members; torsion; bending; shear/moment diagrams; combined loading; stability intro.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 123; Level at least 2A Mechanical Engineering.

courses.name: Materials Engineering 1
courses.description: Microstructure of crystals/amorphous materials; deformation, fracture; phase equilibria; diffusion; strengthening; heat treatment.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: CHE 102; Level at least 2A Mechanical Engineering. Antireq: MTE 111.

courses.name: Algorithms, Numerics and Computation
courses.description: Algorithmic and numeric methods for engineering computation and modelling.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 101; Level at least 2A Mechanical Engineering.

courses.name: Thermodynamics 1
courses.description: Energy and the First/Second Laws; properties, control mass/volume analyses; entropy; cycles; equilibrium criteria.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: MATH 118; Level at least 2B ME. Antireq: MTE 309, SYDE 381.

courses.name: Mechanics of Machines
courses.description: Kinematics and kinetics of particles and rigid bodies; work-energy and impulse-momentum methods; vibrations intro.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 123; Level at least 2B ME.

courses.name: Electromechanical Devices and Power Processing
courses.description: Review of circuits; EM basics; DC machines, synchronous generators, transformers, induction motors; intro to drives and power electronics.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: Level at least 2A ME.

courses.name: Kinematics and Dynamics of Machines
courses.description: Geometry of motion, linkages, gears, cams; mechanism synthesis/analysis; vibration basics; transmissibility and isolation.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 219 and ME 251; Level at least 3A ME.

courses.name: Mechanical Design 1
courses.description: Design process; static failure of ductile/brittle materials; fatigue; design of welds, bolts, springs, shafts.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 219; Level at least 3B ME.

courses.name: Manufacturing Processes
courses.description: Casting, forming, machining, joining; materials-process-design interactions; cost and rates.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 230; Level at least 3A ME.

courses.name: Heat Transfer
courses.description: Conduction, convection, radiation; heat exchangers; numerical methods.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 250; Level at least 3A ME.

courses.name: Fluid Mechanics 1
courses.description: Properties and fundamentals; hydrostatics; conservation laws; similarity; laminar/turbulent flow; pipe flow; forces on bodies.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 250; Level at least 3A ME.

courses.name: Introduction to Control Systems
courses.description: Open/closed-loop control; modelling; block diagrams; Laplace methods; stability; modes of control; analog simulation.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 203 and ME 321; Level at least 3B ME.

courses.name: Fluid Mechanics 2
courses.description: Potential and viscous flows; lubrication; boundary layers; turbulence; compressible flow; turbomachinery fundamentals.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 351; Level at least 3B ME.

courses.name: Instrumentation and Measurement
courses.description: Measurement systems; sensors and transducers; DAQ; uncertainty; experimental methods.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 240; Level at least 3B ME.

courses.name: Mechanical Engineering Design Workshop
courses.description: Full-term team design project applying the design process; often includes prototype build/test.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: Level at least 3B ME. Antireq: MTE 380.

courses.name: Introduction to Mechatronics
courses.description: Sensors/actuators; signal conditioning; microcontrollers; real-time interfacing; system integration.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 269; Level at least 3B ME.

courses.name: Mechanical Design 2
courses.description: Advanced machine elements (clutches, brakes, couplings, bearings, gears); reliability; optimization; synthesis project.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 322; Level at least 4A ME.

courses.name: HVAC Load Analysis and Design Fundamentals
courses.description: Psychrometrics; duct design; IAQ & comfort; heating/cooling loads; conduction; solar gains; infiltration.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: Level at least 4A in Architectural, Chemical, Civil, Environmental, or Mechanical Engineering.

courses.name: Energy Conversion
courses.description: Conventional, nuclear, and renewable energy conversion systems; performance and design considerations.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 4A ME (typ. with ME 343/353) or equivalent; see calendar for details.

courses.name: Mechanical Engineering Design Project 1
courses.description: Capstone design project – proposal, specs, planning, initial/detailed design.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 380; Level at least 4A ME. Antireq: MTE 481.

courses.name: Mechanical Engineering Design Project 2
courses.description: Continuation of ME 481 – final detailed design and proof of feasibility.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 380 and ME 481; Level at least 4B ME. Antireq: MTE 482.

courses.name: Advanced Dynamics and Vibrations
courses.description: Planar & 3D rigid body motion; Newton/Lagrange methods; linear vibration; modes; stability; intro to nonlinear simulation.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 321; Level at least 4A ME/MTE.

courses.name: Robot Manipulators: Kinematics, Dynamics, Control
courses.description: DH convention; forward/inverse kinematics; Jacobians; dynamics; trajectory generation; joint control; sensing; industrial applications.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 360 or MTE 360; and ME 212 or SYDE 182; Level at least 4A ME/MTE. Antireq: ECE 486.

courses.name: Computer-Aided Design
courses.description: Geometric modelling (wireframe, surface, solid); parametric/feature-based design; curves/surfaces (Bezier, B-splines, NURBS); labs.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 321 and ME 322; Level at least 4A ME/MTE.

courses.name: Finite Element Methods
courses.description: FEM fundamentals; element derivation; assembly; BCs; solvers; applications to heat transfer, fluid flow, stress; basic FE coding.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 219 and ME 240 (or equivalents); Level at least 4A ME/MTE.

courses.name: Fluid Power Control Systems
courses.description: Hydraulic/pneumatic circuits; valves; pumps and motors; transmissions; sealing/filtration/thermal control; applications.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: ME 351 and ME 360 (or MTE 360); Level at least 4A ME/MTE.

courses.name: Air Pollution
courses.description: Air pollution sources, atmospheric dispersion, measurement, and control technologies.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: Level at least 4A ME or permission of instructor.

courses.name: Energy Systems Modelling and Optimization
courses.description: Methods for modelling, analysis, and optimization of energy systems; case studies.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: Level at least 4A ME or permission of instructor.

courses.name: Introduction to Systems Design Engineering
courses.description: Introduction to systems thinking, design methods, and the SYDE program.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 1A SYDE.

courses.name: Introduction to Systems Design Engineering Laboratory
courses.description: Laboratory activities supporting SYDE 101.
courses.prerequisites: Coreq: SYDE 101.

courses.name: Physics 1: Mechanics
courses.description: Kinematics and dynamics of particles and rigid bodies; energy and momentum methods.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 1A SYDE.

courses.name: Digital Computation
courses.description: Programming fundamentals and numerical methods for engineering computation.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 1A SYDE.

courses.name: Human Factors in Design
courses.description: Human-machine systems; user needs; information processing and sensory processes; ergonomic design.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 1B SYDE. Antireq: BME 162.

courses.name: Physics 2: Dynamics
courses.description: Particles and rigid-body kinematics/kinetics; energy & momentum methods; vibrations.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 1B SYDE or 2A MTE. Antireq: BME 182.

courses.name: Digital Systems
courses.description: Combinational/sequential logic; state machines; microcomputer interfacing.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 1B SYDE. Antireq: BME 292/393.

courses.name: Calculus 3
courses.description: Vector calculus; line/surface integrals; ODEs and systems; numerical methods for ODEs.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 2A SYDE or 2A BME.

courses.name: Probability and Statistics
courses.description: Probability, random variables, common distributions, estimation, hypothesis tests, regression, goodness-of-fit.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 2B SYDE. Antireq: BME 213, CIVE 224, ECE 316, NE 115.

courses.name: Physics 3: Electricity and Magnetism
courses.description: Electrostatics, circuits, magnetostatics, electromagnetic induction.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 2A SYDE.

courses.name: Data Structures and Algorithms
courses.description: Structured software design; ADTs; recursion; algorithm analysis; sorting/searching; hashing; NP-completeness.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 1B SYDE or CE Option. Antireq: BME 122, CS 240/241E, ECE 250, MTE 140.

courses.name: Linear Systems and Signals
courses.description: Discrete/continuous-time systems; Z/Laplace/Fourier transforms; transfer functions; sampling; filters; stability.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 2B SYDE or 2B ME or 2B MTE. Antireq: BME 252.

courses.name: Design, Systems, and Society
courses.description: Technology-society-environment interactions; frameworks and evidence-based analysis to inform design choices.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 2A SYDE.

courses.name: Engineering Economics of Design
courses.description: Business plans, pricing, production, evaluating investments, depreciation, new product economics.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 2B SYDE. Antireq: BME 364, MSCI 261.

courses.name: Mechanics of Deformable Solids
courses.description: Stress-strain; axial, torsion, bending; shear/moment; instability intro.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 2A SYDE. Antireq: BME 281, CIVE 204, ME 219.

courses.name: Circuits and Systems
courses.description: Circuit analysis and modelling for linear systems.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 2A SYDE.

courses.name: Statistics 2
courses.description: Linear models: regression and ANOVA; diagnostics; model selection; intro to non-linear regression and factorials.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: BME 213 or SYDE 212 (min 70%); 3A BME or 3B SYDE. Antireq: STAT 331, 371.

courses.name: Optimization
courses.description: Optimization theory and algorithms for engineering systems; linear, nonlinear, discrete; applications.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 3A SYDE.

courses.name: Software Design and Architecture
courses.description: Software requirements, architecture, patterns, testing, maintenance; group project.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: SYDE 223.

courses.name: Human Factors in Systems Design
courses.description: Advanced human factors with applications to complex systems.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: SYDE 162.

courses.name: Introduction to Control Systems
courses.description: Classical and state-space control; stability; root locus; frequency response; PID; labs alt weeks.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 3B SYDE. Antireq: BME 353.

courses.name: Control Systems Laboratory
courses.description: Laboratory for SYDE 352.
courses.prerequisites: Coreq: SYDE 352. Antireq: BME 353L.

courses.name: Thermodynamics
courses.description: Classical thermodynamics with intro to heat transfer and statistical thermodynamics; energy & environment applications.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 3A SYDE. Antireq: BME 384, MTE 309, ME 250.

courses.name: Fluid Mechanics
courses.description: Statics/kinematics/dynamics of fluids; conservation laws; dimensional analysis; internal flows; intro to BL/ideal/compressible flow.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 3A SYDE. Antireq: ME 351.

courses.name: Systems Design Capstone Project Preparation
courses.description: Project planning, requirements, and preliminary design activities ahead of capstone.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 4A SYDE.

courses.name: Decision Analysis and Risk Management
courses.description: Decision analysis under uncertainty; utility, Bayesian updating, risk evaluation, and applications.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: SYDE 212.

courses.name: Systems Design Capstone Project 1
courses.description: First half of two-term capstone project following SYDE design sequence.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 4A SYDE.

courses.name: Systems Design Capstone Project 2
courses.description: Second half of capstone project; continuation from SYDE 461.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 4B SYDE.

courses.name: Design Optimization Under Probabilistic Uncertainty
courses.description: Optimization under uncertainty: stochastic/dynamic programming, chance constraints, reliability, tolerance design; applications.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: Level at least 3B SYDE (recommended).

courses.name: Introduction to Complex Systems
courses.description: Nonlinear dynamics, bifurcations, power laws, statistical inference for complex systems; case studies on global issues.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: Level at least 3A BME or 3B SYDE.

courses.name: Conflict Resolution
courses.description: Decision-making with multiple participants/objectives; graph model, normal form, negotiation, uncertainty, MCDA; decision support & applications.

courses.name: Biomedical Measurement and Signal Processing
courses.description: Biomedical signals (EMG, EEG, ECG), instrumentation, and signal processing for feature extraction/applications.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: One of BIOL 273, BME 284, SYDE 384/584; Level at least 3A BME or 3B SYDE or 3B Life Physics (Biophysics).

courses.name: Rehabilitation Engineering
courses.description: Assistive technologies, prosthetics/orthotics, and rehabilitation system design.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: 4A BME or 4A SYDE or instructor consent.

courses.name: Biomedical Systems Modelling
courses.description: Mathematical modelling of physiological systems and biomedical processes.
courses.prerequisites: Prereq: SYDE 384 or equivalent; 4A BME/SYDE.
